blocks.arabic_text: أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ لَمْ تَمَسَّ جِلْدَهُ النَّارُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: "Whoever, after praying Fajr, remains engaged in the Dhikr of Allah until the sun rises, and then prays two or four rak'ahs (of Ishraq), the fire of Jahannam will not touch even his skin" — Hazrat Hasan ibn Ali (RA) narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ صَلَّي الْفَجْرَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ ثُمَّ قَعَدَ يَذْكُرُ اللهَ حَتَّي تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ، ثُمَّ صَلَّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ كَانَتْ لَهُ كَأَجْرِ حَجَّةٍ وَعُمْرَةٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: تَامَّةٍ تَامَّةٍ تَامَّةٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال:هذا حديث حسن غريب باب ماذكر مما يستحب من الجلوس ...،رقم:٥٨٦
blocks.tamil_translation: "Whoever prays the Fajr Salah with congregation, then remains engaged in the Dhikr of Allah until the sun rises, and then prays two rak'ahs of Nafl, receives the reward of a Hajj and an Umrah," said Rasulullah ﷺ. Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) says that the Prophet ﷺ said three times, "He will receive the reward of a complete Hajj and Umrah, the reward of a complete Hajj and Umrah, the reward of a complete Hajj and Umrah."

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ يَقُولُ: ابْنَ آدَمَ لَا تَعْجِزَنَّ مِنْ أَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ أَكْفِكَ آخِرَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد ورجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد:٤٩٢/٢
blocks.tamil_translation: "O son of Adam! Do not become unable to pray four rak'ahs at the beginning of the day! If you pray them, I will take charge of your affairs for the whole day" — that Allah says this, the Prophet ﷺ said, as Hazrat
